case_metadata.case_name: North Sea Operational Maritime Pollution Incident

candidate_morphology.morphological_interpretation: Elongated continuous surface slick aligned with wind-shear axis

evidence_gate.recommendation: Eligible for physics simulation. Automatically initiate OpenDrift hindcast and forward response forecast.

response_intelligence.q1_what_was_observed: Calibrated dual-polarization Sentinel-1 SAR backscatter depression displaying 11.2 dB VV damping and 8.7 dB VH damping over an area of 1.24 km2.
response_intelligence.q2_is_it_plausibly_oil: YES (PHYSICS_ELIGIBLE). Strong backscatter suppression, high dual-pol contrast, and elongated streak morphology rule out biogenic film and low-wind false positives.
response_intelligence.q3_where_is_it_moving: Moving East-Northeast (068 deg) at ~0.32 m/s driven by 12 kn Southwesterly winds (ERA5) and North Sea tidal residual currents (GLORYS).
response_intelligence.q4_resources_at_risk: Threatened coastal habitats: Dogger Bank protected marine zone (48 km ENE) is within the 48h trajectory cone. Immediate nearshore shoreline impact in next 24h is LOW.

evidence_factors: Crossed centroid of probable release envelope at 2024-04-09T21:15:00Z
Speed anomaly: speed dropped from 14.2 kn to 7.8 kn in release corridor
Track heading (065 deg) matches initial slick elongation azimuth
Passed through regional corridor 2.3 hours prior to estimated release
Constant cruising speed (12.4 kn) with no heading deviation

q7_uncertainty_and_limitations.model_uncertainty: Empirical OIL_EVIDENCE_SCORE from OilSeg V1 SmallUNet. Values represent relative backscatter damping confidence, not calibrated Bayesian probabilities.
q7_uncertainty_and_limitations.metocean_forcing_uncertainty: ERA5 atmospheric model spatial resolution (0.25 deg, ~25 km) smooths localized sub-mesoscale coastal wind gusts.
q7_uncertainty_and_limitations.ais_attribution_limitation: AIS tracking is purely circumstantial spatiotemporal evidence. AIS presence or absence does not establish legal responsibility. Physical chemical sampling or aerial verification required.
